answer: Coordinated gas escrow: each root identity must acquire a non-transferable nectar token before its agents can transact jointly. Tokens accrue only through verified pairwise interactions, and a relic of past coordination is required to unlock the knoll of shared liquidity pools. Attacker cost: N distinct identities each need N-1 genuine interactions to reach threshold, making coordination O(N²) in real work rather than one registration fee.
